rows.en: ＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１７Hi, Cousin. Something's been on￥my mind, so I came by...
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１８What's going on with you lately?￥Those scores aren't like you,￥Cousin...
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０１９Did something happen? Are you￥feeling sick or something?
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２０If something's bothering you,￥why not talk to me about it?
Nothing's wrong.
Just leave me alone.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２１Really?￥Then that's even weirder!
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２２Getting scores like that when￥nothing's wrong... It's like￥you've just stopped caring!
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２３I'm... the only family you've￥got here, you know?
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２４If something seems off with you,￥of course I'll worry, right?
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２５Or is my worrying a bother too?
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２６Cousin.￥I'm worried about you, okay?＝＠１３９＿０２７I thought maybe something￥was troubling you...
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２８But don't tell me...
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０２９You haven't really lost all￥your motivation, have you?
No, it's not that.
Actually, I have.
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０３０Oh, good. Then that's fine! You￥can just try harder next time!
＊Kaname＊＠１３９＿０３１Huh... you have?￥So you're not even interested￥in Elan anymore...?
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００１Maybe I was being nosy...￥But I was worried about you,￥Cousin.
＊Kaname＊＠１３７＿００２I guess I said too much.￥I'm sorry...
